title: Lighthouse pages
description: The pages Lighthouse measures (lighthouserc.cjs on pull requests, scripts/lighthouse.ts weekly), on the seeded network of scripts/dev-network.ts.

path.description: The page's path and query, on the seeded network.

account.description: The seeded account the page is measured signed in as: dj (neon.test) or admin (ada.test). Signed out without one.

pr.description: Also measured on pull requests that change what the pages are built from (web-ci.yml), against lighthouserc.cjs's budgets.
